items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, public beta, public data display, alert expansion, rights-dependent affiliate or advertising expansion, and external outreach. Recommendation: keep the gated product private, retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked, and continue containment-only execution. Evidence: upstream API access is documented, but storage, derivatives, display, caching, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising rights are not established; technical compliance is only 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required for upstream rights and jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment. Ordinary reversible growth is conditional only when existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries are preserved.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Progress: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed; all remain open: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. No task is closable on current evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required because written permission, field-level provenance and rights, permitted storage/caching/display/derivatives/alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price, affiliate, and advertising terms are missing. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed because data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are missing. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed because deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment are missing. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed because log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures are missing. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Compliance, data-quality, analytics, revenue, and site evidence do not support broader claims. Analytics is materially present but yellow because permissions or collector errors remain; incomplete telemetry is not itself a launch blocker, but unavailable values remain unknown. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the aggregate amount is not site-attributable, so do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal lift. For complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com, retain parked status because both are scaffold sites with analytics unconfigured and compliance reachability unavailable. Next evidence action for each: complete a timestamped private-site checklist covering reachability, content, disclosures, terms, consent/cookie behavior, analytics status, monetization status, and an explicit retain-parked or prepare-launch disposition.

No go-live proposal is supported. Keep launch_gate private_only; do not use a go_live implementation gate. Public exposure, alert expansion, rights-dependent monetization, deployment, configuration or credential changes, new telemetry, spend, and external outreach remain unauthorized. Continue only existing repair-or-close, measurement reconciliation, attribution-boundary, and bounded legal/security evidence work.
